eventCandidates.uncertainty: Presidential public opposition/limitation position is documented; police operational command for later committee assault requires separate proof.
Need ministry directive and cabinet/presidential authorization chain.
Do not attribute the bill architecture to Rhee or Cho Bong-am until bill drafts and committee minutes are compared.
Promulgation is established; drafting, delay and later election implementation need separate sub-events.
Separate massacre command, attempted investigation obstruction, ministerial responsibility, prosecution and judgment.
Paek's negotiating role is direct; precise presidential instructions remain to be sourced.
Election result is anchored; campaign administration and irregularity claims require separate evidence.
Government allegations are actor claims; court findings must be decomposed charge by charge and later retrial added.
Later judgment supports individual responsibility for named officials but does not by itself establish every alleged presidential instruction.

adversarialChecks.claim: Rhee personally ordered all operational actions against the anti-collaboration committee
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Three presidential statements establish policy hostility/limitation; operational police command remains a distinct evidentiary question.

adversarialChecks.claim: Ahn Ho-sang acted solely on presidential instruction in teacher screening
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Chronology attributes ministerial action; cabinet/presidential directive not yet opened.

adversarialChecks.claim: Cho Bong-am alone designed the 1949 land reform law
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Assembly passage and Agriculture Ministry explanatory text do not by themselves establish sole authorship.

adversarialChecks.claim: Rhee's promulgation proves he initiated every element of local autonomy law
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Promulgation and legislative authorship are separated.

adversarialChecks.claim: Geochang massacre responsibility can be collapsed into the presidency
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Indictment, witness evidence, ministerial resignations and military judgment reveal multiple command/accountability layers.

adversarialChecks.claim: Paek Tu-chin merely attended economic-aid negotiations ceremonially
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: His July 8 signed negotiating letter and Aug.6 meeting role show substantive negotiation.

adversarialChecks.claim: The 1956 election can be summarized only as Rhee versus Cho Bong-am
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Official result also preserves deceased Democratic candidate Shin Ik-hui and large invalid/commemorative-vote context requiring treatment.

adversarialChecks.claim: Government's 1958 deregistration allegations prove the Progressive Party platform itself was unconstitutional
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: 1959 Supreme Court summary explicitly states the platform and peaceful-unification position were not themselves unconstitutional.

adversarialChecks.claim: The 1960 official vote totals are valid electoral outcome data
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Official chronology itself marks the election cancelled due to fraud.

adversarialChecks.claim: Later convictions of election officials prove a complete presidential direct-command chain
adversarialChecks.counterSearch: Later judicial finding names individual criminal responsibility; direct presidential command needs its own evidence.
